description: This file implements POSIX thread-specific data key management functions, including creation, deletion, setting, and getting thread-specific data keys and values, with internal data structures and synchronization mechanisms.

methods.name: pthread_key_create
methods.description: Creates a thread-specific data key with an optional destructor.

methods.name: pthread_key_delete
methods.description: Deletes a thread-specific data key and frees associated data.

methods.name: pthread_setspecific
methods.description: Associates a thread-specific value with a key for the calling thread.

methods.name: pthread_getspecific
methods.description: Retrieves the thread-specific value associated with a key for the calling thread.
